verdict.rationale: Community Phone's business plans document call routing, forwarding, simultaneous and rollover ringing, a dial menu, custom greetings and "advanced call routing." None of the evidence mentions business-hours schedules, open/closed behavior, or holiday handling per number. These routing features are adjacent controls, not the time-based business-hours capability, so the applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number
